Thank you for the meal! ...Though I do have a question.

Is there a reason you've not taken any for yourself?
I have no sense of taste
Get you as fat as I can~
Wait, really? Tasting was one of your stolen powers? Or something even worse??
I'm so sorry to hear that. I can hardly think of a fate so terrible.
...Even so, you should eat. I can't have you slimming down on me.
Wh-huh~??
I mean, I appreciate the thoughts, truly~!
However, I've always been one for mutual fattening~
Here, take some. We can share.
Mhm, it tastes better eating with a friend~
If you do happen across any more, let me know. I'd love to share it with you.
You're taking some too, right?
...Hrm. There's something that's been stuck in my mind.
You've brought me so much food. And with that, I've been able to locate your powers.
However, on the very edge of my senses, I swear I feel even more.
Guess I need to keep eating until I can locate it proper, huh?
Hm... it's large. Leagues greater than what the others took.
It's almost as if they're trying to hide it from me...
They must really want to keep it, huh?
Now that you've helped me eat, it's only fair I help you!

Let me mark their lair on the map.
Stay safe! Don't topple the forest with your weight!
Your next shard is down. Deep, deep, deep, deep down...
Good hell, how deep did they go?! Either your power is that good, or they are that heavy...
...They aren't alone. This place makes my fur stand on end. It seems... wrong.
I guess... let me mark their lair on the map.
Don't die down there, Echo. The world needs blobs like us.
I appreciate the meal, but I've no more help to give.
Perhaps we can just... chat? One fat beast to another?

I caught her digging around a lot. I hope I helped.
Hm? Is somebody there?
Oh, a dragon. Hello.
I've felt your presence for some time. You are a friend.
You appear to be stuck as well. Let me lend you a hand.
The mole wants to destroy our home. Sonia is her name.
She digs the caverns bare, all for worthless pyrite.
If you are able, please stop her.
Hm? Who is there?
Dragon? Oh, welcome. I didn't recall you being so... large.
You defeated Sonia? Amazing! Though, I hardly think eating her was needed.
Hm? You gained weight for other reasons? Ah well.
If Sonia is gone, then I do hope that handsome wolf with the hammer takes charge.
He seems the most responsible. He understands the power of a proper curse.
Oh? Hello, little dragon.
I do wish we could meet under happier circumstances, but I am glad to meet regardless.
This cavern used to be an underground forest, but that horrid mole has been digging up our roots.
Were it not for her, we would be in a golden age!
...Hm? You are chasing the same mole as well? She stole your powers?
Well, if our interests align, perhaps I can lend you what energy I have left.
Our flowers grant flight to those who touch them.
Their powers are weakened, and your mass may also prove an issue, but they may still help.
The mole's hideout is atop this tower. If you wish to reach it, you will need more help.
Seek out my sisters, red and blue in hue, deeper in these caverns. They can help more.
Thank you, kind dragon.
My apologies again for missing the fight. I hadn't realized the others were there.
I'm glad I could've helped out in the end, at least.
And you must admit, my contribution was... how you say, \bad of ass?\""
I did kind-of save the day at the last second with that one, you must admit.
